newsitem.title: INDIA: India's Ranbaxy to acquire Gufic brands.
newsitem.headline: India's Ranbaxy to acquire Gufic brands.

text.p: India's Ranbaxy Laboratories said on Monday it would acquire a substantial part of the pharmaceuticals business of the Bombay-based Gufic Group of Companies, comprising several well-known brands.

"Under the arrangement, a substantial part of the pharmaceuticals (ethical formulations) business comprising well-established brands such as Mox, Suprimox, Zole, Excel, etc is to be acquired by Ranbaxy," Ranbaxy said in a statement.
Mox is the brand leader in India's amoxycillin market, the statement said. Ranbaxy will source the products being acquired from Gufic under a toll manufacturing agreement, it added.
Gufic will continue with its other businesses of bulk drugs, herbal and over-the-counter products, Ranbaxy said.

Ranbaxy said it expects the acquisition of Mox to considerably strengthen its pre-eminent position in the antibiotics segment. Zole and Exel will position it well in the fast-growing skin preparations segment, it added.
